review_status: Completion guards and owner/closure mechanics are compatible; one downstream failure-reason mapping issue remains

locations: executor.py close_family and failed/invalid cell rows
findings.title: Compact readout does not receive the retained failure/unlaunched reason
findings.evidence: The executor uses row.unavailable_reason for unlaunched rows and row.error for timeout/invalid/exception rows, but the existing readout consumes only row.reason. It therefore replaces actual retained causes with the generic No complete original endpoint in compact collection and unavailable O-cohort records. Ordinary nonzero exits may additionally retain only exit_code/failure binding. The full executor ledger preserves these details, but they do not survive the current compact readout contract.
findings.required_fix: Populate the existing row.reason field before closure for every noncomplete row, preserving its error/unavailable_reason or an honest nonzero-exit/failure-receipt explanation. Alternatively map those existing fields at the readout boundary. Preserve original fields and bindings; no training, dispatcher, source-family, selection or supervisor redesign is needed.

source_checks: The frozen six-condition/three-seed roster, constructor be_init, lambda0.5 and full100 epochs/25800 updates match the adoption. The unchanged dispatcher execs the original public single/independent4 driver or allocation O/I/P/G driver, with complete bound TRAIN/development roles and fresh outputs; no training loop or selector is copied.

Completion guards match actual public RUN/COMPLETE/PROGRESS keys, task/arm/seed, core/native/driver hashes, role hashes and original selected digest. Policy counters correctly require two-view25800 updates,51600 Session forward calls,206400 member forwards, P3 versus O/I/G2 reverse calls per step, and100 complete development evaluations/3300 batch calls/13200 member calls. No malformed completion guard that would reject ordinary full fits was found.

Ordinary independent4 retains the original final assembled own-selected endpoint plus OWN_BEST_BANK.json and all four own_best files by hash. No checkpoint is deserialized, spliced or reselected by this executor. Readout receives selected/metadata bindings in its expected whole-family schema.

Per-cell active32390 plus cleanup10 equals hard32400; global583200 bounds18 cells. A new cell is admitted only when its complete cap fits before outer cleanup reserve. Zero exit/full endpoint/source custody and actual in-cap artifact checks are required for complete status. Timeouts remain failures without shortening or retry.

Every normal/emergency group signal freshly checks the saved leader PID/start_ticks/group/session. A missing/reaped leader never permits a numeric-only PGID signal. Cleanup-custody uncertainty, unreaped children and emergency orphan cleanup prevent terminal readiness; actual exit/reap evidence is not fabricated.

The outer parent actually waits/reaps the family owner, accounts for all18 rows on ordinary/fatal termination, and binds closure bytes into the expected terminal-evidence schema. Its family handle and attempted cell handles have the readout's required pid/start_ticks/exit/reaped/children_terminal fields. Observed outer overrun or active timeout blocks readout readiness; root readout release remains separate.
limits: Source inspection and static byte custody only. No server, current receipt/outcome, model, numeric role payload, checkpoint or TEST access; no numerical invocation or source-entry execution.
Root must still establish actual same-host/exclusive GPU readiness and authorize the exact sealed execution. Runtime feasibility and all future owner/reap/closure/readout receipts remain unverified.
This review supplies no numerical parity gate, method-quality conclusion or new supervisor framework.
